result.summary: The page layout is mostly intact, but the first card in the 'Popular right now' section has a failed/missing image, leaving a large grey placeholder with a broken-image glyph. The favorite button on that card also renders with a mismatched grey background compared with the other cards.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows no restaurant photo — instead a large empty grey block with a broken-image icon is displayed, unlike all other cards which render imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL / loading logic for this listing and provide a branded fallback (e.g. cuisine illustration or restaurant initial) instead of a raw broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the broken Tokumaru card renders on a light grey translucent circle with a grey outline icon, whereas the same button on the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white icon — inconsistent styling and weak contrast against the light grey placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite-button treatment (fixed dark scrim circle with white icon) regardless of whether the underlying image loaded.

issues.description: The placeholder image block is noticeably shorter/differently proportioned than the neighbouring pizza card image, making the list rhythm uneven.
issues.suggestion: Enforce a fixed aspect ratio on the card media container so placeholders occupy the same height as loaded images.
